BUPATI PASANGKAYU
MEMUTUSKAN:
Menetapkan: PERATURAN DAERAH TENTANG PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN  DAN ANAK.
translated_text:
REGENT OF PASANGKAYU
DECIDES:
To Establish: REGIONAL REGULATION ON THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN.

text:
BAB I
KETENTUAN UMUM
Pasal 1
Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:
1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Pasangkayu.
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati sebagai unsur  penyelenggara Pemerintahan Daerah yang memimpin  pelaksanaan urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan  daerah otonom.
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Pasangkayu.
4. Perangkat Daerah adalah unsur pembantu Bupati dan DPRD  dalam penyelenggaraan Urusan Pemerintahan yang menjadi  kewenangan Daerah.
5. Perempuan adalah manusia dewasa berjenis kelamin  Perempuan dan orang yang oleh hukum diakui sebagai  Perempuan.
6. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 tahun,  termasuk Anak yang ada dalam kandungan.
7. Perlindungan adalah segala tindakan pelayanan untuk memenuhi hak-hak, serta menjamin dan melindungi hak korban tindak kekerasan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Pasangkayu Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Pasangkayu.
4. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region.
5. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person who is legally recognized as a Woman.
6. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including a Child in the womb.
7. Protection is all service actions to fulfill rights, as well as guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence.

text:
JDIH KABUPATEN PASANGKAYU
8. Perlindungan Perempuan adalah upaya yang ditujukan untuk  melindungi Perempuan dan hak-haknya agar mendapatkan  rasa aman dari tindak kekerasan.
9. Perlindungan Anak adalah segala kegiatan untuk menjamin  dan melindungi Anak dan hak-haknya agar dapat hidup,  tumbuh, berkembang, dan berpartisipasi, secara optimal  sesuai dengan harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan, serta  mendapat perlindungan dari kekerasan dan diskriminasi.
10. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat atau yang  mengakibatkan kesengsaraan dan penderitaan baik fisik,  seksual, psikologis termasuk penelantaran, ancaman  tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan atau perampasan  kemerdekaan secara sewenang-wenang, baik yang terjadi di  depan umum atau dalam kehidupan pribadi.
11. Korban tindak kekerasan yang selanjutnya disebut korban  adalah perseorangan atau kelompok orang yang mengalami  penderitaan baik fisik, mental maupun emosional, kerugian  ekonomi, atau mengalami pengabaian, pengurangan atau  perampasan hak-hak dasarnya, sebagai akibat pelanggaran  hak asasi manusia, atau tindak pidana serta tindak kekerasan  yang dilakukan baik oleh aparat negara atau aparat  Pemerintah Daerah atau oleh orang perorangan.
12. Pelayanan adalah kegiatan dan tindakan segera yang  dilakukan oleh tenaga profesional sesuai dengan profesi  masing-masing berupa konseling, terapi dan advokasi guna  penguatan dan pemulihan Korban kekerasan.
13. Rencana Aksi Daerah adalah merupakan landasan dan  pedoman bagi dinas terkait, dan masyarakat, dalam rangka  melaksAnakan kegiatan penyelenggaraan perlindungan  terhadap Perempuan dan Anak Korban tindak Kekerasan.
14. Rumah Aman adalah tempat tinggal sementara, yang  diberikan untuk memberikan perlindungan terhadap Korban  sesuai dengan standar yang telah ditentukan.
translated_text:
JDIH KABUPATEN PASANGKAYU
8. Perlindungan Perempuan (Protection of Women) is an effort aimed at protecting Women and their rights in order to obtain a sense of security from acts of violence.
9. Perlindungan Anak (Protection of Children) is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, as well as receive protection from violence and discrimination.
10. Kekerasan (Violence) is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including neglect, threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.
11. Korban tindak kekerasan (Victims of acts of violence) hereinafter referred to as victims are individuals or groups of people who experience suffering whether physical, mental or emotional, economic loss, or experience neglect, reduction or deprivation of their basic rights, as a result of human rights violations, or criminal acts as well as acts of violence committed either by state apparatus or Regional Government apparatus or by individuals.
12. Pelayanan (Services) is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of Victims of violence.
13. Rencana Aksi Daerah (Regional Action Plan) is the foundation and guideline for related agencies and the community, in the context of implementing activities for the provision of protection to Women and Children Victims of acts of Violence.
14. Rumah Aman (Safe House) is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to Victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Article 5
Physical violence as referred to in Article 4 letter a is caused by acts that result in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and/or causing death.

text:

translated_text:
Article 6
Psychological violence as referred to in Article 4 letter b is caused by acts that result in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person.

text:
Pasal 7

a. perbuatan yang berupa pelecehan seksual;
b. pemaksaan hubungan seksual; dan/atau
c. pemaksaan hubungan seksual dengan orang lain untuk  tujuan komersial dan atau tujuan tertentu.
translated_text:
Article 7
Sexual violence as referred to in Article 4 letter c consists of:
a. acts in the form of sexual harassment;
b. forced sexual intercourse; and/or
c. forcing sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and or specific purposes.

a. perbuatan yang mengeksploitasi ekonomi atau seksual dengan maksud untuk menguntungkan diri sendiri atau orang lain;
b. perbuatan yang dengan atau tanpa persetujuan Korban yang  meliputi tapi tidak terbatas pada pelacuran, kerja atau  Pelayanan paksa, perbudakan atau praktek serupa,  penindasan, pemerasan, pemanfaatan fisik, seksual, organ  reproduksi, atau memanfaatkan tenaga atau kemampuan seseorang oleh pihak lain untuk mendapatkan keuntungan  baik materiil maupun immateriil; dan/atau

translated_text:
Article 9
Exploitation as referred to in Article 4 letter e is caused by:
a. acts that exploit economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others;
b. acts with or without the consent of the Victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or Services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or exploiting the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial; and/or
c. all forms of exploitation of sexual organs or other organs of the Victim to obtain benefits that are not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse.

(2) Fasilitas kesehatan komprehensif sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) berupa pusat kesehatan masyarakat dan rumah  sakit.
(3) Kesehatan komprehensif sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  meliputi upaya promotif, preventif, kuratif, dan rehabilitatif,  baik untuk Pelayanan kesehatan dasar maupun rujukan.

(5) Pemerintah Daerah melaksanakan kegiatan untuk menunjang  pemberian air susu ibu kepada bayi.
translated_text:
Article 17
(1) Regional Governments are obligated to provide comprehensive health facilities for Children.
(2) Comprehensive health facilities as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in the form of community health centers and hospitals.
(3) Comprehensive health as referred to in paragraph (1) includes promotive, preventive, curative, and rehabilitative efforts, both for basic health services and referrals.
(4) Comprehensive health as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be provided free of charge for families who are unable to afford it or poor families.
(5) Regional Governments shall carry out activities to support the provision of breast milk to infants.

text:

translated_text:

(1) Regional Governments are obligated to provide basic and secondary education for Children.
(2) In providing education as referred to in paragraph (1), Regional Governments shall provide educational cost assistance or free education for students who come from poor families and/or neglected Children.

text:

Article 19
(1) Regional Governments are obligated to shelter and/or care for Children who are neglected by their parents and/or family.
(2) The sheltering and/or care of Children as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out through cooperation with institutions, social foundations, or Orphanages.

Pasal 20

a. dasar yang terdiri atas pangan, sandang, pemukiman, pendidikan, kesehatan, belajar dan berekreasi, jaminan  keamanan, dan persamaan perlakuan; dan

Article 20
(1) The Regional Government is obligated to provide special Protection for Child Victims of riots or Victims of natural disasters.
(2) Special protection as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in the form of fulfillment of needs:
a. basic needs consisting of food, clothing, shelter, education, health, learning and recreation, security guarantees, and equal treatment; and
b. special needs for Children with disabilities and Children experiencing psychosocial disorders.

Article 21
(1) Regional Governments are obligated to undertake prevention of efforts and acts of violence against Children.
(2) Prevention efforts as referred to in paragraph (1) are carried out in the form of activities that include:
a. early detection and intervention;
b. socialization, seminars or workshops;
c. preparation of an effective information system; and
d. cooperation with institutions that have activities in the prevention of acts of violence against Children.

BAB VI
PENANGANAN TINDAK KEKERASAN TERHADAP  PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK
Pasal 25
(1) Pemerintah Daerah menyiapkan tenaga medis di pusat  kesehatan masyarakat atau di rumah sakit yang khusus  menangani Korban Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak.
(2) Tenaga medis sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) wajib  memberikan layanan kesehatan secara lengkap kepada  Korban Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VI
HANDLING OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN AND CHILDREN
Article 25
(1) The Regional Government shall prepare medical personnel at community health centers or at hospitals specifically to handle Victims of Violence against Women and Children.
(2) Medical personnel as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be obligated to provide complete health services to Victims of Violence against Women and Children.

text:
Pasal 26
(1) Pemerintah Daerah wajib membantu penyediaan ruangan khusus bagi Korban Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak.
(2) Ruangan khusus sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) berada  di Kepolisian Resort dan di setiap Kepolisian Sektor di Daerah.
translated_text:
Article 26
(1) Regional Governments are obligated to assist in the provision of special rooms for Victims of Violence against Women and Children.
(2) Special rooms as referred to in paragraph (1) are located at the Resort Police and at every Sector Police in the Region.

Article 27
(1) Social workers or volunteer personnel as referred to in Article 24 paragraph (1) letter b are tasked with accompanying Victims in facing the process of resolving acts of violence.
(2) In carrying out the duties as referred to in paragraph (1), social workers or volunteer personnel conduct activities:
a. counseling or guidance to strengthen and provide a sense of security for Victims;

b. memberikan informasi mengenai hak Korban untuk  mendapatkan Perlindungan dari kepolisian dan penetapan  perintah Perlindungan dari pengadilan;
c. mengantarkan Korban ke Rumah Aman atau tempat  tinggal alternatif; dan
d. melakukan koordinasi terpadu dalam memberikan  layanan kepada Korban dengan instansi atau pihak terkait  yang dibutuhkan Korban.

Pasal 28

(1) Regional Governments are obligated to prepare Safe Houses.
(2) Safe Houses as referred to in paragraph (1) are used for temporary handling of Victims of Violence against Women and Children.
(3) Safe Houses as referred to in paragraph (2) are provided in every Sub-district.

text:
Pasal 29
(1) Advokat sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 24 ayat (1) huruf  c membantu memberikan layanan hukum bagi Korban atau  memberikan konsultasi hukum berupa informasi mengenai  hak Korban dan proses peradilan;
(2) Advokat wajib mendampingi dan/atau mewakili Korban di  tingkat penyidikan, penuntutan, dan pemeriksaan dalam  sidang pengadilan.
(3) Informasi kekerasan dari Korban yang bersifat pribadi wajib  dirahasiakan oleh advokat.
(4) Advokat dapat melakukan koordinasi dengan sesama penegak  hukum, relawan pendamping, dan pekerja sosial agar proses  peradilan berjalan sebagaimana mestinya.
translated_text:
Article 29
(1) Advocates as referred to in Article 24 paragraph (1) letter c assist in providing legal services for Victims or provide legal consultation in the form of information regarding the rights of Victims and the judicial process;
(2) Advocates must accompany and/or represent Victims at the investigation, prosecution, and examination levels in court proceedings.
(3) Information on violence from Victims that is personal in nature must be kept confidential by advocates.
(4) Advocates may coordinate with fellow law enforcers, volunteer companions, and social workers so that the judicial process proceeds as it should.

text:
Pasal 30
Rohaniawan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 24 ayat (1)  huruf d bertugas:
a. memberi bimbingan rohani atau penguatan iman dan taqwa  kepada Korban; dan
b. memberikan penjelasan mengenai hak dan kewajiban Korban.
translated_text:
Article 30
Religious counselors as referred to in Article 24 paragraph (1) letter d have the duty to:
a. provide spiritual guidance or strengthening of faith and piety to Victims; and
b. provide explanation regarding the rights and obligations of Victims.

Article 32
(1) Regional Governments conduct supervision in the context of Protection of Women and Children.
(2) Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through monitoring and evaluation.
(3) Monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (2) is implemented periodically at least 2 (two) times per year.

PERAN SERTA MASYARAKAT

b. memberikan informasi setiap kondisi yang cenderung  mengarah pada tindak kekerasan terhadap Perempuan  dan Anak kepada pihak yang berwenang dan/atau  Pemerintah Daerah; dan/atau
translated_text:

COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION
Article 33
(1) The community participates in efforts to protect Women and Children.
(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out in the form of:
a. providing data or information regarding Women and Children who have not yet received fulfillment of rights from the Regional Government;
b. providing information on any conditions that tend to lead to acts of violence against Women and Children to the authorized parties and/or the Regional Government; and/or

BAB IX
PENDANAAN
Pasal 34
(1) Pendanaan atas penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan  dan Anak dibebankan pada:
a. anggaran pendapatan dan belanja negara;
b. anggaran pendapatan dan belanja daerah; dan
c. sumber lain yang sah dan tidak mengikat.
(2) Pendanaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf a  dianggarkan pada Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan  urusan pemerintahan dibidang pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak.
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX
FUNDING
Article 34
(1) Funding for the implementation of Women and Child Protection shall be charged to:
a. state revenue and expenditure budget;
b. regional revenue and expenditure budget; and
c. other legal and non-binding sources.
(2) Funding as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a shall be budgeted to Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women and Child empowerment.

TENTANG
PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK
I. UMUM
Perlindungan dari kekerasan yang mengancam keselamatan  Perempuan dan Anak harus diberikan sejak dini. Perlindungan diperlukan  untuk mencegah adanya kekerasan dan eksploitasi fisik, mental dan  seksual. Misalnya Perempuan dan Anak menjadi Korban penganiayaan,  penelantaran, pengusiran dan perlakuan buruk oleh orang tua ataupun  orang lain. Bagi Perempuan dan Anak yang mengalami masalah tersebut  Pemerintah Daerah harus menyediakan Rumah Aman dan anggaran yang  memadai.
Demikian pula dengan peran berbagai pihak untuk membantu  menangani persoalan kekerasan yang dihadapi oleh Perempuan dan Anak  harus sinergi dengan program dan kegiatan Pemerintah Daerah. Organisasi  sosial kemasyarakatan, relawan, tenaga sosial, tenaga medis advokat dan  rohaniawan juga harus digerakkan dan dapat berpartisipasi memberikan  dan meningkatkan rasa aman bagi Perempuan dan Anak.
Bagi Pemerintah Daerah Kabupaten Pasangkayu langkah konkrit  melahirkan payung hukum guna memberikan dan meningkatkan rasa aman  serta mencegah tindak kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak, dengan  membentuk Peraturan Daerah tentang Perlindungan Bagi Anak dan  Perempuan. Untuk selanjutnya penyelenggaraan perlindungan Perempuan  dan Anak dilaksAnakan berdasarkan asas : keadilan; penghormatan  terhadap hak-hak Korban; keadilan dan kesetaraan gender; non  diskriminasi; dan kepentingan yang terbaik bagi Korban.

ON
REGIONAL REGULATION OF PASANGKAYU REGENCY
NUMBER 9 YEAR 2019
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Protection from violence that threatens the safety of Women and Children must be provided from an early stage. Protection is necessary to prevent physical, mental and sexual violence and exploitation. For example, Women and Children become Victims of abuse, neglect, eviction and ill-treatment by parents or other people. For Women and Children experiencing such problems, the Regional Government must provide Safe Houses and adequate budget.
Likewise, the role of various parties to help address violence issues faced by Women and Children must be in synergy with the programs and activities of the Regional Government. Social community organizations, volunteers, social workers, medical personnel, advocates and religious leaders must also be mobilized and can participate in providing and enhancing a sense of security for Women and Children.
For the Regional Government of Pasangkayu Regency, a concrete step is to create a legal umbrella in order to provide and enhance a sense of security as well as prevent acts of violence against Women and Children, by establishing a Regional Regulation on Protection for Children and Women. Furthermore, the implementation of protection for Women and Children is carried out based on the principles of: justice; respect for the rights of Victims; gender justice and equality; non-discrimination; and the best interests of Victims.
